description: This Java source file defines an abstract superclass 'BaseCustomizableMetadata' that extends 'BaseChangeableOpenmrsMetadata' and implements 'Customizable'. It manages a set of attributes that can be added, retrieved, and marked as voided, supporting customization features in the OpenMRS CRM system.

classes.name: BaseCustomizableMetadata
classes.description: Abstract class supporting customizable attributes for openmrs metadata entities, allowing addition, retrieval, and management of user-defined attributes.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns the set of attributes associated with this metadata entity.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Sets the entire collection of attributes for this entity.

methods.name: getActiveAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of non-voided (active) attributes.

methods.name: getActiveAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of active attributes filtered by a specific attribute type.

methods.name: addAttribute
methods.description: Adds an attribute to the entity and sets its owner.

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.description: Replaces existing attributes of the same type with a new one, voiding existing if necessary.
